entry.title: New: dsh-api
entry.summary: Exposes dsh's internal capabilities (language, workspace registry, agent-status and approval events) over HTTP under /dsh-api on the local loopback socket dsh already listens on, with SSE fan-out at /dsh-api/events. Exact install spec: github:lilming123/dsh-api. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
